scope: Read-only audit of unattended test entry points, explicit protocol fixture wiring and native probe settings. No real-provider inference was run for this audit.

evidence.basis: Codex and ACP request tests explicitly execute python3 with tests/fixtures/settings.py.
Native protocol events are supplied by a local Python fixture.
provider.command resolves to tests/fixtures/claude.py for every SDK protocol case.
SDK pathToClaudeCodeExecutable is set from provider.command.
Reads JSON from stdin and returns fixed metadata/results; no model or network request.
Evaluation validators and protocol scenarios are explicitly synthetic/offline.

manual_native_probe.risk: Configured/native defaults can select high reasoning; do not use unchanged defaults as the release probe policy.
manual_native_probe.release_policy: Explicit minimal supported effort in temporary probe configuration; no max/xhigh inference; separate quota authorization.

development_agents: Coding and independent review agents may use xhigh/max under the separate owner instruction; their model usage is not claimed to be zero.
